name: readme-capture
description: Extension Firefox de capture de contenus de veille vers la base Notion Readme center

scripts.test:contract: (test -f tests/contract/.karate/karate-2.1.4.jar || curl -fsSL --create-dirs -o tests/contract/.karate/karate-2.1.4.jar https://github.com/karatelabs/karate/releases/download/v2.1.4/karate-2.1.4.jar) && (set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; java -jar tests/contract/.karate/karate-2.1.4.jar run -g tests/contract -o tests/contract/.karate/reports tests/contract)
